core_philosophy: Growth-oriented diversified portfolio blending broad U.S. and international equity exposure with sector tilts in technology and healthcare, anchored by dividend income and inflation-protected bonds.
behavioral_commitment: Stay the course through market volatility. Rebalance on schedule, not on emotion. Avoid performance chasing and recency bias.

intentional_overlap.SCHD_and_VTI: SCHD overlaps with VTI in large-cap U.S. dividend payers. This is intentional to tilt toward quality income without abandoning broad market exposure.
intentional_overlap.VXUS_international: VXUS provides broad international diversification complementing the U.S.-heavy equity allocation.
